mapper.update: UPDATE resource_dependency edge SET description=declaration.declaration_payload ->> 'description',updated_at=#{now} FROM permission_dependency_declaration declaration WHERE edge.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND edge.delete_flag=0 AND edge.owner_service_code IN #{service} AND declaration.id=edge.declaration_id AND declaration.tenant_id=edge.tenant_id AND declaration.source_service=edge.owner_service_code AND declaration.delete_flag=0 AND edge.description IS DISTINCT FROM declaration.declaration_payload ->> 'description'
